critique: The interface demonstrates strong functional clarity with well-organized modal groupings and clear information hierarchy, but the visual execution feels unresolved—particularly the stark contrast between the playful colored chord buttons and the austere monochromatic UI shell. The piano keyboard anchoring provides excellent behavioral grounding, yet the color coding system (red/green/blue for C/E/G) lacks semantic connection to musical theory, creating a disconnect between the visceral design choices and the educational purpose.
